name: graphhelm-development-contracts
description: Data-only entry skills for proposing development contracts, gathering and citing evidence, curating lessons, scoping changes with Keel, and auditing tests through public read surfaces and advisory artifacts.

interface.shortDescription: Contract the change, cite the evidence, propose the lesson.
interface.longDescription: Entry skills for contract-first development. code-contract states scope, refusal cases and evidence obligations before code exists. context-retrieval assembles evidence, cites it by stable item identity, and declares what it did not retrieve. memory-curator proposes durable lessons as advisory candidates only. keel scopes the change, measures write surface, and names its proof. test-audit guides test authoring, suite audits, and deletion records that name a covering observer. These skills read through public surfaces and propose artifacts; none enforces, publishes, or mutates.
defaultPrompt: Contract the change before writing it, cite the evidence the contract depends on, and propose what was learned once it lands.
